exposure: conventional treatments such as magnesium sulfate

integrated traditional Chinese and Western medicine
finding: The combination of traditional Chinese and Western medicine reduced blood pressure in women with severe preeclampsia and improved maternal and infant outcomes after cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
mod_finding: The combination of traditional Chinese and Western medicine significantly improved maternal and infant outcomes after cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
